newsitem.title: USA: Asahi/America sues MFRI over patent.
newsitem.headline: Asahi/America sues MFRI over patent.

text.p: Asahi/America Inc said Wednesday that it has instituted a patent infringement suit in the United States District Court in New York against MFRI Inc, its associated companies, and one of their officers.

The company said it is seeking both a temporary injunction and a permanent injunction, as well as past damages and attorney's fees from MFRI for its manufacture, use and sale of any double containment piping system using restraint couplings covered by Asahi/America U.S. Patent No. 4,930,544.
Asahi/America said the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office recently confirmed the validity of this patent in a reexamination proceeding.
MFRI said it had not yet had time to review the suit and declined to comment.
Asahi/America makes thermoplastic valves, piping systems and components for use in semiconductor manufacturing, chemical processing, pharmaceutical manufacturing and waste treatment.
